lessons.title: What is Artificial Intelligence?
lessons.description: Explore the definition of AI, its historical milestones, the Turing Test, and the distinction between Narrow AI, AGI, and Superintelligence.

lessons.title: Intelligent Agents & Environments
lessons.description: Understand the perception-action cycle, agent architectures (reflex, goal-based, utility-based), and environmental properties.

lessons.title: Problem Solving & State Space Search
lessons.description: Model problems as state spaces. Compare uninformed search (BFS, DFS) with informed heuristic search (A* and greedy search).

lessons.title: Knowledge Representation & Expert Systems
lessons.description: Investigate propositional logic, semantic networks, production rules, forward/backward chaining, and the limitations of symbolic AI.
